name: Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Thinker-bf16
context_scaling: The Thinker sub-config of Qwen/Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct, max_position_embeddings 65536. This repo ships the Thinker ONLY: the Talker and code2wav stacks (3,540,613,057 params) were nulled before training and are absent from the checkpoint, whose config.json carries exactly audio_config, text_config and vision_config. Input audio, image, video or text; output text only - there is no speech synthesis here.
attention_variant: Inherited unchanged from Qwen/Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct: 0 full GQA layers (kv heads 1, head_dim None) and 0 other layers, per the base config.json.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-31. The Thinker of Qwen/Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct with a QLoRA adapter merged back to bfloat16, fine-tuned on SLURP spoken-intent classification. Not a like-for-like 30B clone: the Talker and code2wav stacks (3.54B params) were removed, so this checkpoint is 31.72B of the whole 35.26B parent and is text-output-only - no speech synthesis, and the card is emphatic about it. This is the strongest evidence in the batch and the reason it is recorded at 0.6: 500 held-out SLURP test items, per-item hits stored so the comparison is an exact McNemar test on paired outcomes (47/10 discordant, p=7.51e-07, 95% CI [+4.51,+10.29]), the scoring harness ships with the numbers, and a 3-bit arm is published as a measured collapse rather than hidden. Two caveats the card states itself: the fine-tune comparison confounds two variables (base arm ran the whole Omni checkpoint, post-merge arms run the Thinker alone), and the task is narrow - a 60-way intent menu from audio, with chance at 1.667%. The 86.80% does not transfer to general capability. Licence metadata says 'other' with license_name apache-2.0; treat as Apache-2.0 inherited from Qwen3-Omni. Repo created 2026-10-11.

benchmarks.name: SLURP intent accuracy (500 held-out)
benchmarks.config: Card arm table '| arm | what it is | accuracy | vs comparator | discordant | p |': row 'omni-base' whole Omni checkpoint bf16 no fine-tune 79.40% (397/500), row 'omni-sft' this repository Thinker-only adapter merged bf16 86.80% (434/500), +7.40, discordant 47/10, McNemar p=7.51e-07 separated, 95% CI on the paired difference [+4.51,+10.29]. 4-shot prompt listing a fixed 60-intent menu, answered as an index; chance 1.667%. Two-variable confound stated on the card.
